what.value: Decide the right carrier (rewrite, zine, hybrid, emergent) for an updated Peeragogy Handbook and produce at least one carrier instance end to end.
what.quote: The Peeragogy Handbook (Wikibooks, 2014–2016) is a 31-chapter book on peer learning that has aged unevenly.

area.quote: Reframe makes that one option among several.
